description: Land Title Settlement Dept. -Kirimatiyawa, Mahawa D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No.5534 (3683)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land settlement matters, specifically the correction and amendment of land titles and ownership details for specific plots in Kurunegala District. It contains detailed land registration information including plot numbers, extents, registered owners, and title references, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
